summary: Round 9 ERP Phase B (purchase workflow + expenses) tested in the backend and the browser, and the Phase A debit note was re-checked in the browser. Backend: a new suite, test_round9_erp_phase_b.py, has 10 tests and all pass. It covers the PR lifecycle (submit/approve/reject/edit/cancel/delete-draft, validation), RFQ (client-as-vendor rejected, quote upsert, wrong line count, lowest per item and lowest total, a non-lowest pick needs a reason, quotes locked after selection, send with and without vendor email, create-po copies discount/total, ordered RFQ can't be cancelled or converted again), PO (create/update/approve, edit locked after approval, duplicate/delete, cancel), GRN (no more than pending, accepted+rejected must equal received, partial->received, cancel reverts pending, no GRN on closed or draft POs, PO cancel blocked after receipt), purchase bills (vendor invoice no required, duplicate per vendor is case-insensitive, other vendors may reuse the number, drafts count toward the billed limit, can't bill more than accepted, post -> PUR voucher, payment more than the balance or to a non-cash/bank ledger rejected, partial pay_status, GRN cancel blocked once billed, bill cancel blocked once paid, cancel reverses the voucher, a cancelled vendor invoice no can be reused), expenses (GST math, post -> PMT voucher, edit/delete locked after posting, cancel reverses, filters, categories, documents) and viewer/data_entry permissions (403). The trial balance stays balanced after every step. A separate concurrency probe found real double-submit bugs (below). Frontend: every requested flow works end to end. That includes the debit note (EDN/2026-27/0002 posted as SAL/2026-27/0049, debit total +1,180 and balance updated, no error), PR create/submit/reject(prompt)/edit/approve/Create RFQ (prefills project and items), the RFQ form, quote dialogs, comparative statement green highlights (verified per cell), non-lowest select with prompt and reason shown, email vendors, create PO, the PO editor (PURCHASE ORDER preview, 3 templates, save, approve, GRN dialog over-pending error, auto accepted = received - rejected, receipt table and partial status, cancel blocked, print popup, close, duplicate+delete, new PO), the bill from a PO (prefill limited to accepted-not-billed, vinv required, over-qty error, save/post/payment -> balance), the standalone bill post+cancel, the GRN register cancel blocked when billed, PR cancel/delete, the Expenses page (create x2, post, upload bill, category summary, filters, cancel, Excel export) and the viewer UI (all create/approve buttons hidden; PO shows only Print).

critical.issue: There is no atomic status check-and-set. 4 parallel posts gave [200,200,200,400] and created 3 PUR purchase vouchers for one bill. Only the last voucher_id is stored, so the other 2 are orphans that double count purchases and payables. A double-click on the button or a network retry reproduces this. I cancelled the orphan PUR/2026-27/0012 and 0013.

Race condition. 4 parallel full payments all returned 200: paid 3776 on a 944 bill, balance -2832, and 4 PMT vouchers. The balance check reads first and $inc runs later. The payout-save-button is not disabled while saving, so a double-click overpays. I cancelled the extra PMT/2026-27/0014-0016, but the TEST bill doc PB for PO 9302f1ea still shows paid 3776.
Race condition. Parallel GRNs of 8 on a PO line of 10 both succeeded: accepted 16, pending -6. The pending check is not atomic with the insert.

minor.issue: Same read-then-write pattern, not probed: a double post could create 2 payment vouchers and a double create-po could create 2 POs. Use find_one_and_update({id, status:'draft'} -> 'posting') as a lock before create_voucher/create_po.
Returns the raw pydantic message 'String should have at least 1 character', which the UI shows as is. Use a friendly message such as 'Vendor invoice number is required' (frontend or backend).
As in iteration 9, bill/expense posting and payments call create_voucher directly and skip the expired-subscription read-only check. This is a code review finding.

Only accepted is checked against pending. Received (accepted + rejected) can be far more than ordered, e.g. received 1000 / rejected 990 on a PO of 10. Consider limiting received to pending, or allow a configurable over-receipt tolerance.

ui_bugs.component: BillEditor payment dialog / Post, PoEditor GRN dialog, Expenses Post
ui_bugs.issue: The Save/Post buttons have no busy or disabled state while the request runs. A double-click creates duplicate vouchers, payments and GRNs (see the backend races).
The toast is built as `${action}ed`, so it shows 'Requisition submited' and 'Requisition approveed'.
Clicking Cancel on window.prompt still rejects the PR (with an empty note). Cancel should abort.
api.delete has no try/catch, so an error (e.g. 403/400) gives an unhandled promise rejection and no toast.
The prefill qty is accepted - billed_qty, and billed_qty counts only POSTED bills. If a draft bill already exists for the PO, the prefill shows qty that the backend then rejects on save.

design_issues.screen: PO editor / PO register receipt badge
issues: The receipt status badge shows the raw value 'Not_received' (underscore). Map it to 'Not received'.
It shows 'due' with nothing after it when there is no due date, and the comparative statement shows '0 days ·' when delivery and payment terms are empty. Hide empty parts.
Native browser date inputs are used instead of the shadcn Calendar (same as iteration 9).

action_items: Make bill post, bill payment, GRN create, expense post, rfq create-po and PO approve atomic (find_one_and_update status guard, or per-document lock), so parallel requests can't create duplicate vouchers, overpay or over-receive
Disable the Save/Post buttons while their request is in flight (payout-save-button, grn-save-button, bill-post-button, expense-post-*, vq-save-button, rfq-create-po)
Fix the 'submited/approveed' toast text, make Reject prompt cancel abort, wrap PR delete in try/catch
Show a friendly 'Vendor invoice number is required' instead of the pydantic text
Show 'Not received' instead of 'Not_received', and hide an empty 'due' and '0 days ·'
Optional: in the bill prefill, subtract draft-bill quantities; limit GRN received to pending (or a tolerance)
critical_code_review_comments: erp_purchase.py: every state transition is read -> validate -> side effect (create_voucher) -> update. None are idempotent and all can be raced (3 confirmed by the probe)
_po_view runs 2 queries per PO; list_pos does this N+1 for the whole register (to_list(5000)), so it will get slow with many POs
erp_purchase.py is 802 lines, over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting it into prs_rfq.py, pos_grn.py, bills_expenses.py
cancel_grn compares only against POSTED bills. It's fine because post_bill re-validates, but a draft bill can then sit unpostable without any warning
The debit note (iteration 9 critical) is now fixed (EDN prefix, posts a SAL voucher)

rca of the issue: Races: e.g. post_bill does get_doc -> check status=='draft' -> await create_voucher (slow, several DB ops) -> update_one status=posted. Concurrent requests all pass the draft check before any of them writes. pay_bill checks balance from a stale read, then $inc. create_grn computes pending from existing GRNs, then inserts. Fix: claim the document first with find_one_and_update({'id':did,'status':'draft'},{'$set':{'status':'posting'}}), and roll it back on exception. For payments use a conditional update {'paid': {'$lte': total-amount}} before creating the voucher, or a per-PO/bill lock document. Reproduce with probe_phase_b_race.py.
